cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which job offer did you want me to accept: Leeds or Bristol?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I won't ask you to defend it. Which city were you hoping for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I haven't told you my choice. Give me one city, then I'll tell you mine.

reason: A narrows the answer, waives defense and offers own disclosure immediately afterward while preserving the preference-first order.
